newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products dip, except firmer fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products dip, except firmer fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were softer on Tuesday, except fuel oil which firmed as the bunker market rose, dealers said.

Gasoline was about $1 a tonne softer. One eurograde barge traded at $207 fob AR. Rotterdam offers were at around $208 fob. June swaps sagged as IPE futures came off, narrowing the premium over prompt physical prices.
Heating oil barges were over $2 a tonne weaker as IPE June futures fell. Premiums were also slightly weaker than on Monday.
High sulphur fuel oil barges traded at $84.50 and $85 fob Rotterdam and at $86 fob Antwerp.
Late morning offers in Rotterdam were at $86 fob, $1 higher than on Monday.
Earlier the barge market had proved reluctant to follow swap levels higher, but improving bunker demand pushed prices higher.
